Learn global sparse-grid weights from retained-data evidence

Source: R/prior_grid_fit.R
susieout_train_prior_grid.Rd

This sensitivity analysis updates only global grid weights. A Dirichlet anchor prevents weakly identified retained-data likelihoods from replacing the externally specified prior.

Usage

susieout_train_prior_grid(
  simulation_bank,
  prior_grid = susieout_prior_grid(),
  nuisance_prior = NULL,
  trained_prior = NULL,
  L = 10L,
  iterations = 50L,
  anchor_strength = length(simulation_bank),
  tol = 1e-06,
  ...
)

Arguments

simulation_bank

Full training loci.

prior_grid

Starting grid and anchor weights.

nuisance_prior

Optional frozen nuisance grid.

trained_prior

Optional frozen effect/nuisance prior.

L

Component limit.

iterations

Maximum mixture-weight updates.

anchor_strength

Dirichlet effective sample size. By default it equals the number of training loci.

tol

Weight convergence tolerance.

...

Additional susieout_fit() arguments.

Value

A learned, frozen susieout_prior_grid.
